gloss: Aomori (prefecture and city in northern Honshu)

definitions.gloss: Aomori (prefecture and city in northern Honshu)
definitions.explanation: The northernmost prefecture of Honshu and its capital city, linked to Hokkaido by the Seikan Tunnel. Known above all for apples and the Nebuta festival.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Aomori grows more apples than any other prefecture, about 60 percent of Japan's crop. The western half of the prefecture is the {津軽|つがる} region, known for its dialect and the {津軽|つがる}⟦{三味線|しゃみせん}→三味線：04464_shamisen⟧.
